primary_question: Can an identity-safe, jointly adapted RSM preserve or improve full-path AttnRes VLA accuracy before token-level ReSkip is enabled?

method.initialization: trained VLM AttnRes router and adapters plus zero-initialized token-conditioned RSM gates

fixed_controls.precision: same StarVLA formal training configuration as the 20260902 Base and AttnRes controls

interpretation_guardrails: The corrected full-path model must be compared with the frozen Base and original AttnRes controls before any skip claim.
Token-level ReSkip remains an inference-time consequence of native AttnRes/RSM signals and receives no separate training.
The superseded direct-transfer RSM run remains archived as negative-transfer evidence and is not pooled with corrected results.
